verdict.rationale: Hoppscotch ships its own MCP server that lets an agent host read and change collections, requests, environments, and teams and send real HTTP requests, so the product can be driven by natural language through an external agent. Its built-in AI features cover only narrow tasks: renaming requests, generating payloads, and writing pre-request scripts and tests. Missing for 10: a native in-app natural-language command interface for general operation, independent or hands-on corroboration of the MCP or AI features, and detail on MCP tool coverage and limits.
